UV Photolysis Studies of Model compounds X and Y

The effects of UV irradiation on compounds X and Y were assessed by exposing their solutions (X in deuterium oxide and Y in deuterated methylene chloride) in quartz NMR tubes to UV light from a Xenon lamp (Ushio UXL-151HO) for specific time periods of 5 min, 15 min, and 20 min to simulate conditions that occur during the SDS-PAGE and HPLC purification process.
